semiconductor_relevance: High - GRITEC AG develops and manufactures customized machines specifically for various applications in the semiconductor industry.
summary: GRITEC AG specializes in the development and manufacturing of high-precision machines for the semiconductor sector, including operating equipment, process systems, and testing systems. They offer tailored solutions for wafer stamping, laser welding, and high-precision alignment, ensuring a single point of contact for project management.
capabilities: High-precision wafer stamping systems for wafers up to 300mm
Laser welding solutions for Class 8 cleanroom applications
High-precision alignment systems for lens to sensor integration
